title: Bug Crawling on a Rotating Disk
body: A bug of mass $$0.020\, \text{kg}$$ is at rest on the edge of a solid cylindrical disk $$(M=0.10\, \text{kg}, $$ $$R=0.10\, \text{m}, $$ $$I=(1/2)MR**{2})$$ rotating in a horizontal plane around the vertical axis through its center. The disk is rotating at $$10.0\, \tfrac{\text{rad}}{\text{s}}.$$ The bug crawls to the center of the disk.
